scope: Encrypted off-site backup of the running restored v0.6.5 instance to an independent provider, retrieved and decrypted independently. Client-side encryption; the provider stores only ciphertext.
independence: different provider AND geography than the primary Backblaze B2 media store (us-east-005); protects against a Backblaze account/provider failure, not only a region outage

encryption.at_rest_proof: raw R2 object magic bytes = b'RCLONE\x00\x00' (rclone crypt header); object names are encrypted, not the plaintext dump names

product_path: deploy/backup.sh with BACKUP_RCLONE_REMOTE=offsite: (the shipped off-site mechanism; no code change)

rclone.note: the distro rclone v1.60.1 emitted a harmless 501 on the mod-time set then succeeded on retry; v1.75.1 uploads cleanly. Operator guidance: use current rclone.

independent_retrieval: from a separate workstation with only the scoped R2 key + the crypt password: rclone crypt cat -> byte-exact match of the host dump, gzip -t OK, PGDMP magic present
not_claimed: This proves off-site push+retrieve+decrypt+integrity on an independent provider. A full restore FROM the off-site copy onto a host reuses the recovery drill's restore (proven separately). Not wired into the production beta deploy here (beta untouched); operator documentation to be added.
